title: [Important] New Analytics API Supports Data Drill Down & Deprecation of Old Versions
breadcrumb: [Important] New Analytics API Supports Data Drill Down & Deprecation of Old Versions
label: TIKTOK SHOP · CHANGELOG
subtitle: Updated 2026-01-25
html:
Summary

The existing Analytics APIs have a new version for 202509, with the primary objective of aligning the data caliber with Seller Center Data Compass. Additionally, 3 new APIs have been added to provide data granularity to help merchants and influencers review, consolidate, and iterate content (video + live) production processes.

Details of the new API endpoints and functions are listed below.

Impact

Impacted market(s) * All markets - local and cross-border
Impacted version(s) * 202509 (and later)

Important Note

Analytic API Versions 202406 and 202409 will be deprecated and offline in April 2026

What's new?

All existing Analytics APIs are now available in all markets. These include:

Endpoint Change Point
Get Shop Performance for Version 202509

1. Align with Seller Center Data Compass data and add more detailed sub-item data (For more details, please refer to the API documentation）
2. Removed the with_comparison field, and now developers can make comparisons by themselves

New Analytics APIs

The following endpoints have been newly launched:

Endpoint Description Version
Get Shop Performance Per Hour Daily performance per hour detail, within 30 days. Including today. 202510
Get Shop LIVE Performance Per Minutes
Get the Live session performance break down to every minute, after the live session is finished.
This API only returns data of live streams hosted by shop official account or marketing account.
Get Shop LIVE Products Performance List Shop related LIVE session (official account & marketing accounts） Sale performance of each product 202512
